text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I thought I could win if I just went *vroooom* like usual...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "I just... I just feel so darn frustrated~~~!"
choice_data_list: Feeling all unsettled, huh... Let's clear that away with some special training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that she had plenty of ability, and depending on where she made her move, the outcome of the race could have been different.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, I'll definitely win next time!
I really do wanna take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Winning with an insane burst of speed at the very end! It feels so good, it's so cool, it's the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right, watch closely, Trainie!
I'm gonna show you how cool I look taking 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that building the strength to not be swayed by race developments
is the surest path to seizing victory.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're totally right! If I just get super duper strong,
I won't have to feel all conflicted anymore!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to win next time,
so teach me how to get as strong as can be!
